title: Detecting Anti-Semitic Hate Speech using Transformer-based Large Language Models
findings: Transformer-based models, particularly BERT, demonstrated superior performance over traditional machine learning classifiers in detecting anti-Semitic hate speech. BERT achieved the highest accuracy and F1-score. Fine-tuning with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) was also effective, improving recall for RoBERTa and F1-scores for LLaMA-2, showing a promising way to enhance performance on pretrained models efficiently.
